cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(dbow2_vendor)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
set(SCHURVINS_DEPENDENCY_DIR "$ENV{SCHURVINS_DEPENDENCY_DIR}" CACHE PATH "Directory populated by prepare_dependencies.py")
if(NOT SCHURVINS_DEPENDENCY_DIR)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Run scripts/prepare_dependencies.py DIR and set SCHURVINS_DEPENDENCY_DIR=DIR")
endif()
set(source "${SCHURVINS_DEPENDENCY_DIR}/DBoW2")
execute_process(COMMAND git -C "${source}" rev-parse HEAD OUTPUT_VARIABLE revision OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE RESULT_VARIABLE status)
if(NOT status EQUAL 0 OR NOT revision STREQUAL "3924753db6145f12618e7de09b7e6b258db93c6e")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "DBoW2 source revision differs from dependencies.lock.json")
endif()
find_package(Eigen3 REQUIRED NO_MODULE)
find_package(glog REQUIRED)
set(OpenCV_DIR "/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/cmake/opencv4" CACHE PATH "System OpenCV")
find_package(OpenCV 4.6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS core features2d)
add_library(DBoW2 SHARED ${source}/src/BowVector.cpp ${source}/src/FBrief.cpp ${source}/src/FORB.cpp ${source}/src/FSurf64.cpp ${source}/src/FeatureVector.cpp ${source}/src/QueryResults.cpp ${source}/src/ScoringObject.cpp)
target_compile_features(DBoW2 PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(DBoW2 PRIVATE "${source}/include/DBoW2")
target_include_directories(DBoW2 PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${source}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include> ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(DBoW2 PUBLIC ${OpenCV_LIBRARIES})
install(DIRECTORY "${source}/include/" DESTINATION include)
install(TARGETS DBoW2 EXPORT export_${PROJECT_NAME} LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
ament_export_dependencies(OpenCV)
ament_export_targets(export_${PROJECT_NAME} HAS_LIBRARY_TARGET)
ament_package()
